content.short: TonUP is a community-driven launchpad on TON focused on identifying and launching high-potential projects safely.
content.description: TonUP is a prominent, community-oriented launchpad dedicated to supporting and scaling high-potential projects on the TON blockchain. It focuses on a rigorous selection process to bring only the best opportunities to its users, backed by a 'Community Protection Plan' that mitigates risks associated with early-stage investing. TonUP serves as a vital incubator for the TON ecosystem, providing projects with the necessary resources and community support to thrive while ensuring a safe environment for participants.
content.meta: Participate in vetted TON launches with TonUP, the community-driven launchpad. Learn more on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
